charts.title: GJ 3929 b: orbits around GJ 3929
charts.description: The orbits of GJ 3929's planets in this map from above, to scale, with GJ 3929 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Beard et al. 2022 (2022ApJ...936...55B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BEARD_ET_AL_2022): P 2.616235 d

charts.title: GJ 3929 b: its transit
charts.description: GJ 3929 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (24, 25, 78) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 188589164, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 7 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min late; 5-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
